content.short: Live feed of NFT offers, sales and more.
content.description:
We focus on giving users live data (updated every 5 seconds) pulled from all NFT projects and piped into a single feed, showing offers and sales as they happen.

We allow users to curate their own feeds, so that they can keep up to date with all of their projects without having to visit multiple different project activity pages on the various marketplaces. We also plan to add other live analytics, such as active whales, active paper-hands etc.

The site is currently free to use, and can be used without needing to connect your wallet. However if you do connect your wallet you will be able to load up your profile on all of your devices
